findings.title: R1 fix is incomplete: all_history/no-from requests and end_of_data+widened period_end_to still report complete over an uncovered range
findings.evidence: service.py:366-389 (_needs_fetch): the period_boundary branch refetches only when period_from is truthy AND period_from < first_stored, so period_from=None (request without period_end_from, or all_history=true where effective_period_from returns None) never refetches; the end_of_data branch returns False claiming 'exhausted in both directions', which only holds for the older edge. Reviewer runs (real CLI): (T2b) narrow fetch then request without period_end_from -> 0 HTTP, status=complete, 10/36 periods; (T2c) narrow fetch then all_history=true -> 0 HTTP, complete, 10/36 periods (2016-2023 missing, advertised=36); (T3b mutation) full fetch to=2026-06-30 (end_of_data), then swapped fixture root whose lrb page1 adds 2026-09-30 (report_count 37), request to=2026-12-31 -> 0 HTTP, complete, 2026-09-30 missing although the provider now serves it (control: intent=refresh picks it up and honestly reports partial/count_changed).
findings.recommendation: Replace the per-terminal approximations with a range-containment check: under period_boundary refetch when period_from is None (or all_history) or period_from < first_stored; under end_of_data refetch when period_end_to exceeds the stored last period (or is unbounded), else downgrade to partial with a named gap (range_not_covered). Add three regressions: no-from, all_history-after-narrow, and to-widening with newer provider data.

findings.title: replay_source publishes another company's statement pages under the requesting company's security_id (cross-entity contamination)
findings.evidence: service.py:536-603 replay_source resolves identity from the request but only looks up the document by primary_source_id (service.py:554) without comparing documents.entity/security to the resolved identity, then _commit_and_publish_page publishes under the request's security. Reviewer run: security master holding both 中微公司/688012 and 美的集团/000333; --replay-source <中微 income source_id> with company_query='美的集团' -> exit 0, status=complete, 10 new financial_statement_versions rows with security_id='000333', entity='美的集团' carrying 中微's income-statement values; subsequent reuse queries for 美的集团 serve that data as local complete.
findings.recommendation: In replay_source verify the source's owning document entity/market/security matches the resolved identity (and the page's code/exchange), refuse mismatches with a named request/identity error and exit 2; add a cross-entity negative regression.

findings.title: continuation contract is inconsistent across paths and effectively dead
findings.evidence: Reviewer runs: (a) reuse_only accepts request.continuation (contracts.py validates it) but handle_reuse_only_request never forwards it - response byte-identical with and without a token, continuation echoed None; (b) service max_rows=20000 is unreachable for CN data (max ~6k rows/table), so the service can never issue a token - paging exists only in repository unit tests; (c) crafted valid token fsv-...:5 on a three-statement request: income resumes correctly (newest report 72 rows, min ordinal 6) but balance_sheet and cash_flow are skipped entirely and returned as status=complete with reports=0.
findings.recommendation: Scope continuation to a single statement (bind statement_type into the token and reject mismatches), either honor or explicitly reject continuation on the reuse_only path, downgrade status to partial when truncated, or mark the field reserved until paging is actually reachable.

findings.title: --replay-source is silently ignored when intent=reuse_only
findings.evidence: cli.py: the reuse_only early-return executes before the --replay-source branch; reviewer run with intent=reuse_only + --replay-source <valid id> returned a plain reuse response (no replay fields) with exit 0 and no diagnostic.
findings.recommendation: Handle --replay-source before the reuse_only early-return, or reject the combination with request_error.

findings.title: Replay output declares financial-statements-response/1 but omits that schema's core payload
findings.evidence: Reviewer run: replay envelope keys are schema_version/request/status/statement_type/source_id/new_version_ids/reused_version_ids/usage - no statements[], no company_identity, no coverage, while schema_version claims financial-statements-response/1.
findings.recommendation: Give replay its own receipt schema (e.g. financial-statements-replay-receipt/1) or populate the response/1 required fields.
